scope: KLAX daily-high probability research using physical marine-layer and offshore-flow evidence

persistent_low_cloud.interpretation: GEFS was nearly unbiased while HRRR was cold

morning_low_cloud_clears.interpretation: realized high tended to fall between HRRR and GEFS

observed_klax.source_class: archived METAR or equivalent provenance-preserving aviation observations
observed_klax.availability_rule: report and archived publication availability must be at or before the 18:00 UTC decision

forecast_vertical_structure.as_of_rule: every object must be historically available by 18:00 UTC

inland_to_coast_pressure_gradient.definition: KLAX mean sea-level pressure minus KDAG mean sea-level pressure in hPa
inland_to_coast_pressure_gradient.interpretation: negative values indicate higher inland pressure and offshore forcing

fixed_derived_features.observed_relative_humidity: Magnus formula from same-report temperature and dewpoint
fixed_derived_features.morning_min_ceiling_ft: minimum valid KLAX ceiling from 12:00 through 18:00 UTC
fixed_derived_features.morning_broken_overcast_fraction: fraction of valid KLAX reports with BKN or OVC
fixed_derived_features.cloud_clearing_indicator: marine signal before 15:00 UTC and no marine signal in latest as-of report
fixed_derived_features.persistent_marine_indicator: latest ceiling at or below 2500 ft AGL with BKN or OVC
fixed_derived_features.offshore_forcing_indicator: coast-minus-inland pressure at or below -2 hPa
fixed_derived_features.onshore_forcing_indicator: coast-minus-inland pressure at or above 2 hPa
fixed_derived_features.season_encoding: annual sine and cosine of day of year

finite_candidate_catalog.description: V8 modal-confusion repair conditioned hierarchically on season and observed marine persistence or clearing
V8 repair conditioned on fixed pressure-gradient, coastal-flow, and inversion states
multinomial logit residual correction with log V8 probabilities as offsets and all fixed continuous physical features
season, observed marine state, pressure-gradient state, and inversion state with partial pooling toward V8
C4 probabilities with a fixed abstention flag for weak-or-mixed flow and high model disagreement; probability scores remain evaluated on all days

development_protocol.predictions: strict expanding-window; current outcome appended only after prediction
candidate_selection_order: lowest mean multiclass Brier among candidates passing every gate
